candidate.rationale: The trait ExecSpecEq already declares the desired postcondition (res == this.deep_view() =~~= other.deep_view()). Adding the identical ensures at the impl level is redundant and flagged by the checker as 'already_specified_via_trait' and leads to harness/import errors. Leave the contract on the trait; if a function-level spec is still desired, address the harness errors (missing imports/private module) rather than duplicating the trait postcondition.
risks: No functional risk in skipping — the semantic contract is already enforced by the ExecSpecEq trait.
If users expect a localized/duplicated spec for readability, they won't see one here; add only after fixing harness scope/import issues.
